layout.arrangement: Red-bordered white slide. Centered red title with blue subtitle at top; slide-number badge top-right. Below, a two-column architecture diagram: LEFT column = encoder stack (lavender 'attention' sub-block on top of a large orange 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks' block, with x₁ x₂ x₃ inputs below and an 'Encoder' label on a gray footer strip); RIGHT column = decoder stack (large yellow 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks' block with o₁ o₂ o₃ outputs above, a lavender sub-block with self-loop arrows below, labeled 'Encoder-Decoder Attention'). A thick red curved arrow and 2-3 dashed pink curves connect encoder side to decoder side. A beige bulleted note box sits bottom-right, overlapping the gray footer strip.

visual_elements.description: Encoder block: large orange rounded rectangle, centered red bold text 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks'. Three thin black vertical input lines enter its bottom edge from x₁ (~15% width), x₂ (~29%), x₃ (~43%).

Decoder block: large yellow rounded rectangle, centered red bold text 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks'. Three thin black up-arrows leave its top edge to o₁ (~58% width), o₂ (~72%), o₃ (~86%); a small black right-pointing arrow exits its right edge at ~47% height.

Encoder attention sub-block: lavender rounded rectangle containing a small white rectangle with gray outline and italic serif text 'attention'; three thin black lines fan from the orange block's top edge up to this box (converging on the box's bottom center).

Decoder attention sub-block: lavender rounded rectangle beneath the yellow block containing two black curved self-loop arrows (each loops from top edge down and back up with an arrowhead, i.e. self-attention loops) at ~70% and ~84% width.

Thick dark-red curved connector: starts at a solid red dot on the orange block's right edge (~48% width, ~60% height), arcs clockwise upward, ends with arrowhead at a red dot on the yellow block's left edge (~53% width, ~48% height). Represents encoder→decoder information flow.
Two or three thin DASHED salmon-pink curved lines running from the encoder 'attention' box region rightward/downward into the decoder lavender sub-block (cross-attention links).

Note box: beige rectangle with thin red outline. Line 1 (red bold): 'Attention Mechanism supports:'. Bullets: '• Parallelization of Encoder ,' / '• Parallelization of Decoder ( Training Mode Only)' / '• Very Long  Sequence length' — the words 'Parallelization' (both bullets) and 'Sequence length' are styled as blue underlined hyperlinks; remaining words black.
Slide-number badge: small light-yellow oval with thin dark outline containing '11' in dark text, top-right corner.

Frame and strips: thin dark-red rectangular border inset ~4% from all slide edges; solid gray horizontal strip across the bottom inside the border; 'Encoder' red bold italic label sits on this strip at left-center.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Only a black mouse cursor with white outline visible over the note box near '( Training Mode Only)' (~77% width, ~89% height) — a screen-recording artifact, not slide content.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial-like) EXCEPT the math symbols x₁/x₂/x₃, o₁/o₂/o₃ and the word 'attention', which are italic serif (Times-like) with true subscripts. Title: very large bold red (#E00000, ~40pt). Subtitle: medium bold blue (#2222CC, ~20pt). Block labels: bold red ~20pt. Section labels: bold ITALIC ~16pt — 'Encoder' and 'Decoder' in red (#E00000), both 'Encoder-Decoder Attention' labels in blue (#2222CC). Note-box heading bold red ~16pt; bullets regular ~15pt with underlined blue (#0000FF) hyperlink words. No all-caps anywhere. Bullets use round '•' glyphs.

recreation_brief: 1. Canvas: 16:9 slide, solid white #FFFFFF background. 2. Frame: no-fill rectangle with thin #C00000 outline, inset ~4% from all four edges (spans ~4-96% of both width and height). 3. Footer strip: solid #BFBFBF rectangle spanning the full inner width at ~93-98% height (~5% tall), inside the frame. 4. Title: centered text 'Transformer', Arial bold ~40pt, #E00000, in the top band (~2-12% height). 5. Subtitle: centered text 'Attention is All You Need', Arial bold ~20pt, #2222CC, directly below the title (~12-20% height). 6. 'Decoder' label: text 'Decoder', Arial bold italic ~16pt, #E00000, in the header band to the right of the centered subtitle (≈65-85% width, ~12-20% height), above the decoder stack. 7. Slide-number badge: small oval at ~90-96% width / ~9-17% height, fill #FFFFCC, thin #808000 outline, centered text '11' at ~14pt in #808000. 8. Encoder block: rounded rectangle at ~5-51% width / ~57-83% height, fill #F7A163, centered text 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks', Arial bold ~20pt, #E00000. 9. Encoder attention sub-block: rounded rectangle at ~11-49% width / ~42-55% height, fill #D6D6F2, no text. 10. 'attention' box: small white #FFFFFF rectangle with thin #999999 outline, centered inside the sub-block from step 9, containing 'attention' in Times New Roman italic ~14pt, #999999. 11. Encoder fan lines: three thin black lines from the top edge of the orange block (~57% height) converging upward on the bottom center of the 'attention' box. 12. Encoder inputs: three thin black vertical lines entering the bottom edge of the orange block at ~15%, ~29% and ~43% width; at the lower end of each line (~84-92% height) place 'x₁', 'x₂', 'x₃' respectively, Times italic ~14pt, black. 13. Decoder block: rounded rectangle at ~50-94% width / ~30-53% height, fill #FFFF00, centered text 'Multi Head Self Attention Blocks', Arial bold ~20pt, #E00000. 14. Decoder outputs: three thin black up-arrows leaving the top edge of the yellow block at ~58%, ~72% and ~86% width; label each arrow tip 'o₁', 'o₂', 'o₃' (Times italic ~14pt, black) at ~23% height. 15. Decoder side arrow: small black right-pointing arrow exiting the right edge of the yellow block at ~47% height. 16. Decoder attention sub-block: rounded rectangle at ~51-89% width / ~53-63% height, fill #D6D6F2, no text. 17. Self-loop arrows: two curved #333333 arrows inside the decoder sub-block at ~70% and ~84% width; each starts on the sub-block's top edge, loops downward and back up, and ends in an arrowhead (self-attention loop). 18. 'Encoder-Decoder Attention' label (encoder side): text 'Encoder-Decoder Attention', Arial bold italic ~16pt, #2222CC, centered above the encoder lavender sub-block (~36-41% height). 19. 'Encoder-Decoder Attention' label (decoder side): same text and style, centered below the decoder lavender sub-block (~64-67% height). 20. 'Encoder' label: text 'Encoder', Arial bold italic ~16pt, #E00000, sitting on the gray footer strip at left-center (~15-30% width, ~93-98% height). 21. Red cross-attention arrow: thick #C00000 curved connector starting at a solid red dot on the orange block's right edge (~48% width, ~60% height), arcing clockwise upward, ending with an arrowhead on a red dot at the yellow block's left edge (~53% width, ~48% height). 22. Dashed cross-attention links: 2-3 thin dashed #FF9E9E curved lines running from the encoder 'attention' box area (~33-49% width, ~45-55% height) rightward/downward into the decoder lavender sub-block (exact count uncertain: 2 or 3). 23. Note box: rectangle at ~48-93% width / ~75-97% height, fill #F0EDE4, thin #C00000 outline; draw it after the footer strip so it overlaps the strip at bottom-right. 24. Note box text: line 1 'Attention Mechanism supports:' in Arial bold ~16pt #E00000; below it three bulleted lines (round '•' glyph, Arial ~15pt): 'Parallelization of Encoder ,' / 'Parallelization of Decoder ( Training Mode Only)' / 'Very Long  Sequence length'; format 'Parallelization' (in bullets 1 and 2) and 'Sequence length' (in bullet 3) as #0000FF underlined hyperlink-style text, all other words #1A1A1A. 25. Do not draw the mouse cursor — it is a screen-recording artifact, not slide content.
